fields.expressions: List[SourceExpression] in original global ExprId order
fields.statements: List[Statement] for selected action in original ordinal order

sourceProgramInterface.positiveDomain: Earlier child IDs, valid roots, admitted prefix typing/names/captures, resolved current environment, successful UInt128 sums. Full source/admission/digest/static-cost/cap/emission prerequisites remain external.

requestInterface.runtimeField: ABSENT. Explicit projection from fixed original Invocation input ignores original runtime evidence.

derivation.expression: Finite worklist visits uncached root before children, then left subtree, right subtree and Add return. Per-statement fresh cache keyed ExprId. Need cache hit adds zero; successful first visits add one logical /2 unit. No source expression effect; UIntAdd uses checked UInt128 success domain.
derivation.bound: One initial tick plus3ticks per arena node suffices for earlier-ID Read/Literal/binary DAGs. Tick count is helper observation bound, not a physical/B/K/Quint fee or logical-work equality.
derivation.environment: Start: normalized source boundary.state then scenario.inputs. Resume: continuation.boundary.state then captures then event values. Normalized Start boundary and admitted plan/source identity remain supplied premises.
derivation.statement: Original ordinal fold. Let evaluates then updates environment only. Next evaluates then updates state and environment and emits one StateEffect; Step.snapshot post-statement, Step.value Some evaluated scalar. Full balances/liabilities preserved.
derivation.await: Initial Start/later Await entry charges one, captures full admitted layout by name in order, stops without guard/Step. Resumed Await evaluates guard: false gives NotAdvanced with counted attempted only, true adds original-source guard Step then continues.
derivation.output: SourceDerived(RuntimeEvidence), with Ran full Execution/exitSite/capturesOut or NotAdvanced. No source result/Step/effect/attempted total is supplied to the evaluator.

unsupported: OutsideSourceFragment/OutsideSourceQueue are model positive-domain markers, never production Error/Rejected values. Supplier exposes no successful prefix if any request is outside fragment; port requires sourceDerivationSupported and nonempty linked queue. Error diagnostics/failed arithmetic/meter denial are unmodeled, not waived.

fixedMachineContract.soleStateVariable: Existing financialBoundary.machine:Machine. No new state fields/driver/cache variable. Evaluator scratch maps/worklists are pure temporaries.
fixedMachineContract.inputHistory: Same B18 identity/plan/guardCosts/source/scenario/event/continuation/startBoundary fields. Runtime replaced only by deriveRuntime(SourceProgram,SourceRequest). Static plan costs are not used to manufacture attempted/runtime outputs.

Root/independent owner decides applicability before new execution; no expected output supplied here.

premisesAndGaps: No parser, full Program/StagePlan digest derivation, normalized Start boundary construction, static type/admission/cap/emit_checked implementation or caller-history synthesis.
Committed prefix calculation remains existing carrier; dynamic attempted values are newly derived per source statements/expressions. No new /2 weights or B/K/helper/physical equivalence.
Read/Literal/UIntAdd/Let/Next/Await only; no financial statements/liability reads/Sub/Mul/otherBinary/Not/Error/auth/H2H3H4H6/loader/native/VM/EARS closure.
